description: Three fixed utility sections: a buffered mult with one input and three outputs, a two-into-two mixer, and a three-into-one mixer

inputs.text: The signal copied to the three outputs of the mult section; a polyphonic cable is copied channel for channel
One of the two signals the middle section adds together
One of the three signals the bottom section adds together

outputs.text: A copy of the signal patched into the mult section
The sum of the two signals patched into the middle section
The sum of the three signals patched into the bottom section

notes: each of the three sections works on polyphonic cables on its own, the number of channels on that section's busiest input setting how many its outputs carry.
this module has no right-click menu of its own.
